description: Phase 6 GraphRAG evaluation fixture. Deterministic lexical embeddings. Tiny local set.
caveat: Evaluation uses deterministic lexical embeddings. Scores reflect token overlap, not semantic understanding. Small fixture size — do not extrapolate to production quality.

queries.note: brake-related queries should surface brake complaints and recalls
vehicle filter should narrow to Ford steering complaints
may return no results if fixture has no electrical data
airbag queries target complaint records mentioning airbags
exact recall campaign query — should find specific recall

metrics.recall_at_1: fraction of queries where expected source is in top-1
metrics.recall_at_3: fraction of queries where expected source is in top-3
metrics.mrr: mean reciprocal rank of first expected-source hit
metrics.note: metrics are meaningful only for queries with non-empty expected_source_keys
